turns.text: Hey, good to reach you! This is Adriene with the Senior Resource Center calling about Medicare. Got a minute for me?
Understood. Just to be sure I've got this right — do you currently have Medicare?
Totally fair — I know this stuff can sound like alphabet soup. Let me explain it in plain English… Let me ask it more simply — are you signed up for Medicare yet?

Tell you what — you can just say 'yes' or 'no', or give me your age as a number. Sorry if that was unclear! In plain words: is Medicare your coverage right now? Or if you'd rather, I can have a licensed specialist walk you through it.

Let me save you the trouble — I'll bring in a licensed specialist who can explain everything properly. Hang tight, I'll transfer you now. Before I bring them in: I'm an independent licensed agent — we're not affiliated with or endorsed by Medicare or the government.
